title: MissChanceMod
description: Adds a configurable miss chance when attacking creatures. By default, 20% of the player's attacks will miss.
body: MissChanceMod is a mod that adds a miss mechanic to Minecraft 1.12.2. By default, 20% of a player's attacks will miss—the hit will deal no damage, a miss sound will play, and a message will appear on the screen. Features Adjustable miss chance via the config file A "Miss!" sound and message will appear for each miss Works with any melee weapon Lightweight and does not affect performance Settings After the first launch, a misschancemod.cfg file will appear in the config/ folder. This file allows you to change the miss chance from 0 to 1 (e.g., 0.2 = 20%). Requirements Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge 14.23.5.2860+
